info.name: Fetch all the headcount in TeamOhana.

params.name: plan-id
params.description: Filter by hiring plan UUID. Get IDs from GET /v1/plans.

params.name: hc-status
params.description: Filter by headcount status code. Repeatable for OR. Valid values: in-approval, approved, denied, closed, archived.

params.name: hc-hiring-status
params.description: Filter by hiring status code. Repeatable for OR. Valid values: not-started, ready-to-hire, in-progress, offer-sent, hired.

params.name: department-id
params.description: Filter by department. Pass the id returned by GET /v1/departments (a division-department UUID that uniquely identifies a department within a division).

params.name: division-id
params.description: Filter by division UUID. Get IDs from GET /v1/divisions. When combined with department-id, returns the union.

items.docs: Get a list of all valid headcount that exists in TeamOhana. Supports optional filtering by plan, status, hiring status, department, and division. Response format is selected via the Accept header (`application/json` default, `text/csv` for a downloadable CSV). Refer to the [Headcount Data API FAQ](/faq/index.html#headcount-data-api) for more details.

info.name: Generate headcount CSV and upload it to pigment

items.docs: Generate the headcount CSV and trigger an async upload to Pigment. Optionally pass time-period in the body (currently only `"this-year"` is supported) to scope the CSV to the org's current fiscal year. Refer to the [Pigment Connector API FAQ](/faq/index.html#pigment-connector-api) for more details.
